pages.text: The ultimate weapon: 13 attack damage, 6000 durability. Each hit sets on fire, inflicts Wither II and heals you for one heart. $(l)Right-click$(): an abyssal wave of fire in front of you (12 damage, 8 s cooldown).
2 netherite ingots, 3 Abyssal Shards, a Nether Star, 2 Onyx Blocks and an Onyx Sword.
